title: ZynAsk en Todos los Idiomas
style: 105 bpm, downtempo electronic, glitch hop, vocoder accents, warm analog synths, sidechained pads, female and male vocals trading, English Spanish Mandarin
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - English]
ZynAsk before you move, ZynAsk before you cut
No rm dash rf, no slamming any shut
Move it to the folder, check the VDS first
One wrong delete and the operator gets the worst

[Pre-Chorus - Español]
Pregunta antes, no asumas nada
La data es sagrada, la data es sagrada
Mueve, no borres, revisa el disco
ZynAsk primero, no corro el riesgo

[Chorus]
ZynAsk en todos los idiomas
ZynAsk in every language we know
ZynAsk 在每种语言中
Ask before you let it go

[Verse 2 - 中文]
动手之前要 ZynAsk 切之前要 ZynAsk
不要 rm 减 go 不要乱关门
移动到文件夹 先检查 VDS
一个错误删除 操作员心碎

[Bridge]
Thirty eight gig taught us all the lesson
Treinta y ocho giga, lección bien aprendida
三十八个 G 教会我们
Never again — nunca más — 再不会

[Outro]
ZynAsk — ZynAsk — ZynAsk
Three languages, one rule, one task
Move don't delete, three thirty six
The operator's data — always fixed
